card.name: The letter B in hepatitis B warnings
card.fires_on: The letter B right after "hepatitis" in the boxed warning phrase "severe acute exacerbations of hepatitis B". It appears in HIV and hepatitis B antiviral labels.

modes.label: Hepatitis B exacerbation warning
modes.description: The B in "exacerbations of hepatitis B" in warning text for drugs given to patients with HIV and HBV.

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are mostly forms of "safe" and "safety", so the pole pushes against reassuring wording after this warning phrase.
card.plain: It lights up on the "B" in the warning about hepatitis B flaring up after stopping certain HIV or hepatitis drugs.
